title: Understanding Bimodal Distribution
text: A bimodal distribution has two different modes or peaks. Consider what kind of plot would help you identify these peaks in the data.

title: Alternative Plot Types
text: Think about plots that show the frequency of data points, such as histograms or density plots. These can help identify multiple peaks in the data.

title: Identifying Plot Types
text: Which plot type is typically used to show the frequency distribution of a dataset?

hintAnswer: It shows the spread of weights for each shape but not the frequency distribution.
title: Analyzing the Current Plot
text: What does the current plot show about the distribution of nugget weights by shape?
choices: It shows the spread of weights for each shape but not the frequency distribution.
It shows the frequency distribution of weights for each shape.
It shows the average weight for each shape.
